newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stainless steel imports up in January-June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stainless steel imports up in January-June.

text.p: U.S. imports of stainless steel products were 293,863 short tons in January to June, up 15 percent from the same period last year, the Specialty Steel Industry of North America said Tuesday.

Total specialty steel imports in the period -- including 31,336 short tons of tool steel and 48,931 short tons of electrical steel -- were 374,129 short tons, up 10 percent from the same year-earlier period.
The group did not give monthly figures for June or weight values for year-earlier imports.
In January to June, imports of stainless sheet and strip were up 12 percent at 181,861 short tons;
stainless plate imports were up 41 percent at 25,975 short tons;
stainless bar imports were up 22 percent at 38,456 short tons;
stainless rod imports were up 18 percent at 34,456 short tons;
and stainless wire imports were down 5 percent at 13,205 short tons.
U.S. stainless steel consumption in January to June was 1,202,170 short tons, up 3 percent from a year earlier; consumption of all specialty steel was up 2 percent at 1,524,756 short tons.
